name: guild
description: Agent orchestration on a local SQL board (tursodb, or a shared Kumiai workspace). Work is a goal, its projects, their requirements and the plans that build them. Each plan names the capabilities it needs, and the roster — the capabilities: frontmatter of the agent files — picks the agent that runs it. Nothing runs until a plan is approved: in a check-in the user approves every plan (approve, deny, or send it back for review); in a shift the orchestrator approves on its own, works on its own branch and stops when it needs the user. A finished project is reviewed by one reviewer agent spawned per lens and slice (requirements, business logic, edge cases, security, architecture, and an audit that runs the project's checks), the findings become issues that get fix plans, and the project is documented into a tagged, linked library. The rules live in the schema: CHECK constraints, views and triggers that record every change. Say 'check in' to start a work session, or 'work a shift' to leave it running.
